answer: A sybil brake is a per-identity collateral lock tied to unique peer attestation. Each new address must escrow 12,500 POA before its first answer is eligible; the escrow stays frozen until five established non-kin peers attest the same text in-epoch. If two of those peers later flag a near-duplicate, the escrow is slashed and the address is barred for four epochs. Cheap extra wallets cannot fund that on-ledger lock at the summit of the intake window, and an ember of a copied draft, even one tinted violet with swapped adjectives, never collects the five attestations needed to release the stake.
